news_items.headline: Middleby Food Processing business rebrands as Midera Food Processing, Inc. ahead of spinoff
news_items.summary: Middleby announced its Food Processing segment will operate under the name Midera Food Processing, Inc. prior to being spun off as a standalone public company via share distribution to existing MIDD stockholders, with completion targeted for early July 2026 pending regulatory approval.

news_items.headline: Middleby agrees to sell 51% stake in Residential Kitchen business to 26North affiliates
news_items.summary: Middleby entered a definitive agreement to sell a majority stake in its Residential Kitchen segment to affiliates of 26North, part of an ongoing strategic portfolio review intended to sharpen focus on Commercial Foodservice.

news_items.headline: Canaccord Genuity raises Middleby price target to $175, maintains Buy
news_items.summary: Canaccord Genuity lifted its price objective on MIDD from $171 to $175 and reiterated a Buy rating, reflecting improved confidence in the company's strategic restructuring progress.

news_items.headline: MIDD Q1 2026 earnings beat with raised guidance; spinoff and beverage momentum highlighted
news_items.summary: Middleby beat Q1 2026 earnings expectations and raised full-year guidance, with management citing beverage platform growth and automation solutions as key revenue drivers, and margin recovery expected in H2 2026 as tariff headwinds ease.

news_items.headline: JP Morgan sets MIDD price target at $185, implying ~25% upside
news_items.summary: JP Morgan initiated or updated coverage of MIDD with a $185 price target, the highest on the Street, citing the restructuring story and Commercial Foodservice focus as the primary upside driver.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Canaccord Genuity raised PT from $171 to $175 (Buy) around 2026-05-27; JP Morgan set PT at $185 on 2026-05-08 (highest on Street). Overall consensus: 11 Buy, 24 Hold, 1 Sell; average PT $166.6.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 beat on revenue and EPS with raised guidance; next earnings expected approximately early August 2026 (Q2). Upcoming Investor Day is a near-term catalyst where management will outline the long-term strategic vision for the post-spinoff Commercial Foodservice entity and the independent Midera platform.
